=> Appending bash_completion source string to /home/rahul/.bashrc
=> Close and reopen your terminal to start using nvm or run the following to use it now:

export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"  # This loads nvm
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/bash_completion" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/bash_completion"  # This loads nvm bash_completion

arguments.command: curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/nvm-sh/nvm/contents/install.sh?ref=v0.40.8" 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json,base64; d=json.load(sys.stdin); open('/tmp/install_nvm.sh','w').write(base64.b64decode(d['content']).decode())" && echo "ok" && bash /tmp/install_nvm.sh 2>&1 | tail -6
